### eHealth Partners with BerniePortal to Provide Integrated CHOICE Arrangements for Employers and Brokers


September 23, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s204.q4cdn.com/837903328/files/doc_news/eHealth-Partners-with-BerniePortal-to-Provide-Integrated-CHOICE-Arrangements-for-Employers-and-Brokers-2026.pdf)


*Partnership expands a new distribution channel for eHealth, helping more employers offer employees a defined contribution toward individual health coverage through the CHOICE model*


INDIANAPOLIS


, Sept. 23, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[eHealth](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4780645-1&h=1091409704&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ehealthinsurance.com%2F&a=eHealth) (Nasdaq: EHTH), a leading private online health insurance marketplace, and[BerniePortal](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4780645-1&h=2648745201&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bernieportal.com%2F&a=BerniePortal) , a human resources and benefits administration platform, today announced a partnership to help brokers and employers offer employees more affordable, personalized health coverage options through Custom Health Option and Individual Care Expense Arrangements, or CHOICE (formerly ICHRA1).


The partnership expands a new distribution channel for eHealth, enabling more employers and brokers to tap into the company's nearly three decades of experience providing personalized support to consumers shopping for individual and family health plans. Brokers and employees can receive personalized guidance and support from eHealth to better understand their options, shop, and enroll in the health plan that best fits their needs.


Under the partnership, more than 5,000 employers and over 1,000 insurance brokers working with BerniePortal can now be connected to eHealth for a needs analysis and support with reviewing CHOICE options. eHealth's licensed insurance agents then help employees use the health benefit dollars provided to them to purchase and enroll in individual and family health insurance plans, often helping businesses reduce their healthcare costs while meeting the coverage needs of employees. CHOICE Arrangements will be managed through BerniePortal's benefits administration platform, helping provide a seamless experience for employers, brokers, and employees.


"Health benefit costs are one of the biggest pressures employers face today, and CHOICE Arrangements can give them a way to offer meaningful coverage while helping reduce the cost unpredictability associated with a traditional group plan," said[Derrick Duke](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4780645-1&h=630100205&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.ehealthinsurance.com%2Fexperts%2Fderrick-duke&a=Derrick+Duke) , CEO of[eHealth](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4780645-1&h=957669526&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ehealthinsurance.com%2F&a=eHealth) . "BerniePortal already works closely with employers and brokers on the ground. By connecting them directly to our team, we can help more employers evaluate CHOICE Arrangements with confidence and give employees additional coverage choices that meet their individual needs."


"Our brokers tell us they want to offer their clients' employees real choice, but with administrative ease. That's what this partnership seeks to deliver: eHealth brings the individual marketplace capabilities, and BerniePortal helps make CHOICE Arrangements easy to run for the broker and HR," said Alex Tolbert, President of BerniePortal.


**Helping employers and benefit brokers deliver CHOICE Arrangements**
The partnership is designed to help brokers and employers offer more seamless CHOICE Arrangements, while making it easier for employees to compare coverage options, including:


- Access to hundreds of Affordable Care Act (ACA)-compliant plans, helping provide seamless and accurate enrollments and making it easier for employees to check coverage status.
- Dedicated support for employers and employees, including assisting with onboarding, shopping, and enrolling.
- Flexibility to structure contributions across employee classes and real-time visibility into enrollments and participation rates.
- Average savings of approximately 17% on healthcare costs.2
- Employer and employee education, including training and onboarding support to help provide a smooth transition.
- Ability for brokers to maintain agent-of-record status and preserve client relationships.


*1* *As of September 3, 2026, the Centers for Medicare and Medicare Services is now referring to Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangements (ICHRA) as CHOICE arrangements.*


*2* *Based on an eHealth analysis of third-party data on individual rates compared to traditional group plan rates in OH, MN, GA, KY, IN & FL.*


**About eHealth**
For nearly 30 years, eHealth, Inc. (Nasdaq: EHTH) has helped millions of Americans find the healthcare coverage that fits their needs at a price they can afford, using data, artificial intelligence and a consumer-first approach to help people quickly and effectively compare insurance options. As a leading independent licensed insurance agency and advisor, eHealth offers access to plans from more than 180 health insurers, including national and regional companies, supporting consumers during their working years and retirement. eHealth's licensed insurance agents help match consumers with the insurance plans, services, and support they need to live healthier, more financially secure lives. For more information, visit[eHealth](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4780645-1&h=957669526&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ehealthinsurance.com%2F&a=eHealth) or follow us on[LinkedIn](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4780645-1&h=1856422933&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4623033-1%26h%3D364518105%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.linkedin.com%252Fcompany%252Fehealthinsurance%252F%26a%3DLinkedIn&a=LinkedIn) ,[Facebook](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4780645-1&h=1009121461&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4623033-1%26h%3D2108616717%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.facebook.com%252FeHealth%252F%26a%3DFacebook&a=Facebook) ,[Instagram](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4780645-1&h=1786479926&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4623033-1%26h%3D2927981036%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.instagram.com%252Fehealthinsurance%26a%3DInstagram&a=Instagram) , and[X](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4780645-1&h=1330941423&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4623033-1%26h%3D140827317%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Ftwitter.com%252FeHealth%26a%3DX&a=X) .

**About BerniePortal**
BerniePortal is the HRIS backed by the benefit brokers trusted by small employers nationwide. Created in 2008, its base edition addresses the complete Benefits Lifecycle from Candidate to COBRA. Employers are able to add additional features, all native to the platform, on an a la carte basis. Additional features include payroll, time tracking, PTO tracking, and more. BerniePortal's distribution network of trusted benefit brokers allows it to keep costs down and pass the savings along to its small employer customers.


BerniePortal media inquiries:os@bernieportal.com
